ValidationRule.description: Billing Country and VAT Number are required if record is not Person Account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Potential__c = FALSE, IsPersonAccount = FALSE, AND( ISBLANK(BillingCountry ), ISBLANK(VAT_Number__c ), SAP_Id__c = '1' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Billing Country and VAT Number are required if record is not Person Account
